Analise o(s) documento(s) de cenário do projeto e gere o SRS completo no formato especificado, seguindo o processo de trabalho: buscas dedicadas na base de conhecimento para cada tipo de artefato, rastreabilidade validada entre os artefatos.

Documento(s) de cenário:
--- Project Scenario 8.pdf ---
BECS (Book E-Commerce System)
So basically what we're trying to do is get books selling 
online instead of however you guys are doing it now, just a 
simple site where people can come in, look through what's 
available, throw a few books in a cart and check out. Nothing 
crazy, I just want it to actually work and not be a headache 
to keep up with. Right now I think it's all kind of manual or 
scattered and there's no real way for someone to just browse 
and buy without someone in the middle handling it, so that's 
the itch we're trying to scratch here. 
 
Anybody coming to the site should be able to just make an 
account, that's it, no big verification process or anything, 
and once they're in they can search for books and see title, 
author, price, add stuff to their cart and go through 
checkout. Keep the search simple, just matching on the title 
and it has to be exact, nothing fancy like partial matches or 
letting people search by author, that's more than we need 
right now. Some of these people might want to sign up to get 
notified about promotions and deals, so let's call those folks 
members, and they're the ones who can use promo codes when 
they check out. I picture this being pretty bare-bones in 
terms of who can buy what, like one copy of each book per 
order is plenty, we don't need people stacking ten copies of 
the same thing in their cart. 
 
On my side of things, I need a way to manage the inventory, 
basically a login that lets me add new books, edit prices, see 
how much stock I've got, that kind of stuff. I also want the 
system to ping me, like an email or something, whenever a book 
is running low so I don't get caught without stock, unless 
I've told it not to bother for that particular book because 
maybe I'm discontinuing it. And I want to be able to set up 
these percentage-off promotions every now and then and have it 
just email all the members automatically when I create one. 
 
One thing I want to be upfront about, we don't need to 
actually process real credit cards or handle real money 
movement right now, just collect the card number as part of 
the checkout flow and spit out a receipt and keep a log of 
what was purchased, who bought it, when. The real payment 
processing piece is something for way later, not part of this. 
Same with security stuff, I know that sounds bad, but honestly 
for what we need right now I'm not worried about encryption or 
people forgetting passwords or whatever, that's not a 
priority, let's not spend time building password recovery or 
anything like that for now. 
 
There's only going to be one person managing the store, me 
basically, so don't worry about building out roles for 
multiple managers or anything fancy like that, and a manager 
should never also be a regular customer account, those are two 
separate hats. It just needs to run somewhere people can get 
to it through a normal browser, nothing exotic on the 
technical side, just something stable that people in here can 
pull up and use without issues.

Sistema: BECS (Book E-Commerce System)

Resumo executivo: BECS is a browser-based book e-commerce system that replaces scattered or manual sales activities with an online catalog, customer accounts, shopping cart, checkout, inventory management, promotions, and purchase records. The system enables customers to browse and purchase books directly while allowing the store manager to maintain inventory and communicate promotions to members.

Escopo: The system shall enable customers to browse, select, and purchase books online while supporting inventory and promotion management by one store manager.
  Em escopo: Customer account registration and login
  Em escopo: Book catalog browsing and exact-title search
  Em escopo: Book details display
  Em escopo: Shopping cart management
  Em escopo: Checkout with card-number collection
  Em escopo: Receipt generation and purchase record storage
  Em escopo: Member registration for promotional notifications
  Em escopo: Promo-code application by members
  Em escopo: Inventory and price management by the store manager
  Em escopo: Low-stock notifications with per-book suppression
  Em escopo: Percentage-off promotion creation
  Em escopo: Automatic promotional emails to members
  Fora de escopo: Real credit-card authorization or money movement — explicitly excluded from the current version
  Fora de escopo: Encryption and advanced security controls — explicitly excluded from the current version
  Fora de escopo: Password recovery — explicitly excluded from the current version
  Fora de escopo: Multiple manager roles — only one manager is required
  Fora de escopo: A manager account also functioning as a customer account — the account types must remain separate
  Fora de escopo: Partial-title search — the scenario requires exact-title matching only
  Fora de escopo: Author-based search — excluded from the current version
  Premissa: PA-01: Customers have access to a standard web browser.
  Premissa: PA-02: An email delivery mechanism is available for manager alerts and member notifications. [INFERIDO]
  Premissa: PA-03: Book prices, stock quantities, and promotion percentages are maintained by the store manager.
  Premissa: PA-04: The manager is represented by a single manager account.
  Restrição: REST-01 (Pagamento): The system shall collect card numbers during checkout but shall not process payments or transfer money.
  Restrição: REST-02 (Segurança): Encryption, password recovery, and advanced security controls are excluded from version v0.1.
  Restrição: REST-03 (Acesso): Manager and customer accounts shall be separate account types.
  Restrição: REST-04 (Plataforma): The system shall be accessible through a standard web browser.
  Restrição: REST-05 (Gestão): The system shall support one store manager only.

Stakeholders:
  STK-01 - Customer (Usuário primário): Create an account, log in, browse available books, search by exact title, view book information, manage a cart, and complete checkout.
  STK-02 - Member (Usuário primário): Receive promotional notifications and apply valid promotional codes during checkout.
  STK-03 - Store Manager (Usuário secundário): Log in separately, manage books, prices, stock, low-stock notification preferences, and percentage-off promotions.
  STK-04 - Email Delivery Service (Stakeholder externo): Receive and deliver low-stock alerts and promotional messages generated by the system.

Regras de negócio:
  RN-001 - Exact-title search: A book search matches only a complete book title and does not match partial titles or author names.
  RN-002 - Single-copy order limit: A customer may purchase no more than one copy of each distinct book in a single order.
  RN-003 - Member promotional eligibility: Only members may use promotional codes during checkout.
  RN-004 - Percentage-off promotion: A promotion applies a percentage discount defined by the store manager to eligible purchases.
  RN-005 - Low-stock notification suppression: A low-stock notification shall not be sent for a book when the store manager has disabled notifications for that book.
  RN-006 - Separate account types: A manager account and a customer account are distinct account types and may not represent the same account.
  RN-007 - Single manager: The store is managed by one manager account.
  RN-008 - Checkout card-number collection: The card number is collected as checkout information without authorizing a payment or transferring money.

Requisitos funcionais:
  RF-001 - Customer account registration: The system shall allow a visitor to create a customer account. [Must have]
  RF-002 - Customer login: The system shall authenticate a customer using the credentials registered for the customer account. [Must have]
  RF-003 - Member registration: The system shall allow a customer to register as a member. [Should have]
  RF-004 - Book catalog browsing: The system shall display the books available for purchase. [Must have]
  RF-005 - Exact-title book search: The system shall return books whose complete title exactly matches the submitted search title. [Must have]
  RF-006 - Book information display: The system shall display the title, author, and price of a selected book. [Must have]
  RF-007 - Add book to cart: The system shall add a selected available book to the customer's cart. [Must have]
  RF-008 - Cart contents display: The system shall display the books currently stored in the customer's cart. [Must have]
  RF-009 - Duplicate-book prevention: The system shall prevent a customer from adding a second copy of the same book to an order. [Must have]
  RF-010 - Checkout initiation: The system shall initiate checkout for a customer with a non-empty cart. [Must have]
  RF-011 - Card-number collection: The system shall collect a card number during checkout. [Must have]
  RF-012 - Promotion-code validation: The system shall validate a promotional code submitted during checkout. [Must have]
  RF-013 - Percentage discount application: The system shall apply the percentage discount associated with a valid promotional code to the checkout total. [Must have]
  RF-014 - Order creation: The system shall create an order containing the books confirmed during checkout. [Must have]
  RF-015 - Receipt generation: The system shall generate a receipt after an order is created. [Must have]
  RF-016 - Purchase-log storage: The system shall store the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date for each order. [Must have]
  RF-017 - Manager login: The system shall authenticate the store manager through a manager account. [Must have]
  RF-018 - Book creation: The system shall allow the store manager to add a book to the catalog. [Must have]
  RF-019 - Book-price editing: The system shall allow the store manager to edit the price of a cataloged book. [Must have]
  RF-020 - Stock-level consultation: The system shall display the current stock quantity for each cataloged book to the store manager. [Must have]
  RF-021 - Low-stock threshold configuration: The system shall allow the store manager to configure a low-stock threshold for a book. [Should have]
  RF-022 - Low-stock notification suppression: The system shall allow the store manager to disable low-stock notifications for a selected book. [Should have]
  RF-023 - Low-stock alert dispatch: The system shall send an email alert to the store manager when a book reaches its configured low-stock threshold. [Should have]
  RF-024 - Promotion creation: The system shall allow the store manager to create a promotion with a percentage discount. [Should have]
  RF-025 - Member promotion notification: The system shall email all members when the store manager creates a promotion. [Should have]

Requisitos não funcionais:
  RNF-001 (Performance Efficiency) - The system shall respond to catalog and book-search requests within 2 seconds. | Métrica: At least 95% of catalog and search requests shall complete within 2 seconds under [TBD] simultaneous users.
  RNF-002 (Performance Efficiency) - The system shall complete checkout submission within 3 seconds. | Métrica: At least 95% of checkout submissions shall complete within 3 seconds under [TBD] simultaneous users.
  RNF-003 (Compatibility) - The system shall operate correctly in the current versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. | Métrica: Zero critical defects in the principal customer and manager workflows on the four supported browsers. Supported version range: [TBD].
  RNF-004 (Reliability) - The system shall maintain monthly availability of at least 99%. | Métrica: Maximum of 7.2 hours of unplanned unavailability per calendar month. [TBD: confirm target]
  RNF-005 (Interaction Capability) - The system shall allow a customer without prior training to complete a purchase using the catalog, cart, and checkout workflows. | Métrica: At least 4 of 5 representative customers shall complete the workflow within 10 minutes without assistance. [TBD: validate target]
  RNF-006 (Functional Suitability) - The system shall preserve the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date exactly as recorded at order creation. | Métrica: 100% of test orders shall contain the correct books, buyer, and purchase date.
  RNF-007 (Maintainability) - The system shall provide technical documentation for installation, configuration, and operation. | Métrica: Documentation shall cover 100% of installation, configuration, manager-operation, and email-configuration procedures. [TBD: approve documentation checklist]

Casos de uso:
  UC-001 - Create customer account | Ator: Visitor
    1. The visitor opens the registration form.
    2. The visitor submits the required account information.
    3. The system validates the information.
    4. The system creates a customer account.
  UC-002 - Log in as customer | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer submits registered credentials.
    2. The system validates the credentials.
    3. The system creates an authenticated customer session.
  UC-003 - Browse catalog | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer opens the catalog.
    2. The system retrieves available books.
    3. The system displays the available books.
  UC-004 - Search book by exact title | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer enters a complete book title.
    2. The customer submits the search.
    3. The system compares the submitted title with catalog titles.
    4. The system displays exact matches.
  UC-005 - Add book to cart | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer selects an available book.
    2. The customer selects the add-to-cart action.
    3. The system adds the book with quantity one.
    4. The system displays the updated cart state.
  UC-006 - Complete checkout | Ator: Customer
    1. The customer starts checkout.
    2. The system displays the cart summary.
    3. The customer submits the card number.
    4. The system creates the order without processing a payment.
    5. The system generates a receipt.
    6. The system stores the purchase record.
  UC-007 - Apply promotional code | Ator: Member
    1. The member enters a promotional code during checkout.
    2. The system validates the member status and code.
    3. The system applies the associated percentage discount.
    4. The system displays the adjusted total.
  UC-008 - Log in as manager | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager submits manager credentials.
    2. The system validates the credentials.
    3. The system opens the manager session.
  UC-009 - Manage book inventory | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager opens inventory management.
    2. The manager adds a book, edits a price, or views stock.
    3. The system validates the operation.
    4. The system saves or displays the requested information.
  UC-010 - Configure low-stock notifications | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager selects a book.
    2. The manager enters a threshold or disables notifications.
    3. The system validates the setting.
    4. The system saves the setting.
  UC-011 - Send low-stock alert | Ator: Email Delivery Service
    1. The system detects that a book reached its threshold.
    2. The system verifies that notifications are enabled for the book.
    3. The system sends an alert to the manager's email address.
  UC-012 - Create promotion | Ator: Store Manager
    1. The manager opens promotion management.
    2. The manager enters the promotion code and percentage.
    3. The system validates the promotion data.
    4. The system creates the promotion.
  UC-013 - Notify members of promotion | Ator: Email Delivery Service
    1. The system detects creation of a promotion.
    2. The system retrieves all members.
    3. The system sends the promotion message to each member.

Critérios de aceite:
  CA-001 - Dado A visitor has provided valid required registration data, quando the visitor submits the registration form, então the system creates exactly one customer account and confirms its creation
  CA-002 - Dado A customer account exists with registered credentials, quando the customer submits valid credentials, então the system creates an authenticated customer session
  CA-003 - Dado An authenticated customer is not currently a member, quando the customer submits the member-registration action, então the system marks the customer account as a member
  CA-004 - Dado At least one book is available, quando the customer opens the catalog, então the system displays every available book in the catalog result
  CA-005 - Dado The catalog contains a book titled exactly "The Example Book", quando the customer searches for "The Example Book", então the system returns that book and does not return books with only partial-title or author matches
  CA-006 - Dado A cataloged book exists, quando the customer selects the book, então the system displays its title, author, and price
  CA-007 - Dado A book has available stock, quando the customer selects Add to Cart, então the book appears in the cart with quantity 1
  CA-008 - Dado The customer has added two distinct books, quando the customer opens the cart, então the system displays both books and their quantities
  CA-009 - Dado A book is already in the customer's cart with quantity 1, quando the customer attempts to add the same book again, então the system keeps the quantity at 1 and displays the one-copy limit message
  CA-010 - Dado The customer is authenticated and the cart contains at least one book, quando the customer selects Checkout, então the system displays the checkout form and cart summary
  CA-011 - Dado The customer is on the checkout form, quando the customer enters a card number, então the system records the card number as checkout information without initiating payment processing
  CA-012 - Dado The authenticated customer is a member and a valid promotional code exists, quando the member submits the code during checkout, então the system accepts the code and identifies its percentage discount
  CA-013 - Dado A valid percentage promotional code has been accepted, quando the checkout total is calculated, então the displayed total is reduced by the percentage defined by the promotion
  CA-014 - Dado The checkout data is valid and all selected books remain available, quando the customer confirms checkout, então the system creates exactly one order containing the selected books
  CA-015 - Dado An order has been created successfully, quando order creation completes, então the system generates a receipt containing the order details
  CA-016 - Dado An order has been created, quando the system stores the order, então the purchase log contains the purchased books, buyer, and purchase date
  CA-017 - Dado The configured manager account exists, quando the manager submits valid manager credentials, então the system grants management access without converting the account into a customer account
  CA-018 - Dado The manager is authenticated and has entered valid book data, quando the manager saves the new book, então the system adds exactly one book to the catalog
  CA-019 - Dado A cataloged book exists and the manager is authenticated, quando the manager saves a valid new price, então the system displays the updated price for that book
  CA-020 - Dado A cataloged book has a recorded stock quantity, quando the manager opens inventory details, então the system displays the recorded stock quantity for the book
  CA-021 - Dado The manager is authenticated and has selected a cataloged book, quando the manager saves a valid low-stock threshold, então the system stores the threshold for that book
  CA-022 - Dado The manager is authenticated and has selected a cataloged book, quando the manager disables low-stock notifications, então the system stores the disabled setting for that book
  CA-023 - Dado A book has reached its threshold and notifications are enabled, quando the system evaluates the book's stock level, então the system submits one low-stock email alert to the manager
  CA-024 - Dado The manager is authenticated and has entered a valid percentage discount, quando the manager saves the promotion, então the system creates one promotion with the configured percentage
  CA-025 - Dado A promotion has been created and three members have registered email addresses, quando promotion creation completes, então the system submits one promotional email for each of the three members

Glossário:
  Book: A catalog item that may be viewed and purchased through BECS.
  Customer: A person with a customer account who browses books and places orders.
  Member: A customer who has registered to receive promotions and use promotional codes.
  Store Manager: The single person responsible for managing the catalog, inventory, prices, notifications, and promotions.
  Promotion: A percentage-off commercial offer created by the store manager.
  Promotional code: A code associated with a promotion and submitted by an eligible member during checkout.
  Low-stock threshold: The stock quantity at or below which the system may notify the manager.
  Receipt: A document or system output summarizing an order after creation.
  Purchase log: The stored record of purchased books, buyer, and purchase date.

Este documento é a base de conhecimento fixa (Vector Store B) do sistema de elicitação de requisitos. Ele ensina ao agente
de IA os padrões de escrita, templates, exemplos e regras de qualidade que devem ser aplicados ao analisar documentos

Base: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 §9.6 · IEEE 830-1998 §3 · Sommerville (2016, cap. 4)
O Documento de Especificação de Requisitos de Software (SRS) é o contrato técnico que descreve o 
que o sistema deve fazer e sob quais condições de qualidade. Ele serve de referência para 
desenvolvedores, testadores, gerentes e clientes durante todo o ciclo de vida do projeto.
1.1 Artefatos Obrigatórios e sua Ordem
Um SRS completo e formal deve conter os seguintes artefatos, nesta ordem:
• ESCOPO: Define o que está DENTRO e FORA do projeto. Evita scope creep.
• STAKEHOLDERS: Lista todos os envolvidos: quem usa, quem financia, quem é afetado.
• PREMISSAS E RESTRIÇÕES: Fatos assumidos como verdadeiros e limites impostos ao projeto.
• REGRAS DE NEGÓCIO (RN): Políticas, fórmulas e condições de negócio que existem independentemente 
do software.
• REQUISITOS FUNCIONAIS (RF): O que o sistema DEVE FAZER — comportamentos, serviços, respostas a 
entradas.
• REQUISITOS NÃO FUNCIONAIS (RNF): Como o sistema deve SER — atributos de qualidade 
quantificáveis.
• HISTÓRIAS DE USUÁRIO (HU): Necessidades na perspectiva do usuário: Como [perfil], quero [ação], para
[benefício].
• CASOS DE USO (UC): Interações detalhadas ator-sistema com fluxo principal, alternativo e exceções.
• CRITÉRIOS DE ACEITE (CA): Condições testáveis em formato BDD (Dado/Quando/Então) que definem 
quando o requisito está concluído.
• GLOSSÁRIO: Termos do domínio com definição precisa para eliminar ambiguidades.
1.2 Como os Artefatos se Interconectam
Os artefatos formam uma cadeia de rastreabilidade. Cada RF deve ter origem em um STK 
(stakeholder) ou RN. Cada HU deve ter pelo menos um RF associado. Cada RF e HU devem ter pelo menos um CA. Esta rastreabilidade garante que nada seja implementado sem justificativa de 
negócio e que tudo que foi prometido seja testável.
Cadeia de rastreabilidade mínima:
STK → (RN →) RF → HU → CA

A ISO/IEC 25010:2023 define 9 características de qualidade do produto. Todo RNF deve ser 
classificado em uma dessas características. A seguir, cada característica com seus sub-atributos e 
exemplo de RNF.
1. Functional Suitability (Adequação Funcional)
 Functional Completeness — o sistema oferece todas as funções necessárias.
 Functional Correctness — as funções produzem os resultados corretos.
 Functional Appropriateness — as funções facilitam a realização das tarefas.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 1. Functional Suitability
O sistema deve calcular o imposto sobre o valor do pedido aplicando corretamente a alíquota de ICMS 
vigente para o estado de destino, conforme tabela oficial CONFAZ, com variação máxima de R$ 0,01 em 
relação ao valor de referência da Receita Estadual.
2. Performance Efficiency (Eficiência de Desempenho)
 Time Behaviour — tempo de resposta e throughput.
 Resource Utilisation — uso de CPU, memória, rede.
 Capacity — limites máximos suportados.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 2. Performance Efficiency
O sistema deve processar no mínimo 200 pedidos por minuto sob carga de 1.000 usuários simultâneos, com 
tempo de resposta inferior a 2 segundos no percentil 95.
3. Compatibility (Compatibilidade)
 Co-existence — coexiste com outros sistemas sem degradação.
 Interoperability — troca dados com outros sistemas.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 3. Compatibility
A API do sistema deve expor endpoints REST/JSON compatíveis com o padrão OpenAPI 3.0, permitindo 
integração com o ERP legado via OAuth 2.0 sem modificações no ERP.4. Interaction Capability (Capacidade de Interação) — antes 'Usabilidade'
 Appropriateness Recognisability — usuário reconhece a adequação do sistema.
 Learnability — facilidade de aprendizado.
 Operability — facilidade de operação.
 User Error Protection — proteção contra erros do usuário.
 User Engagement — interface envolvente e motivadora.
 Inclusivity — acessível a pessoas com diferentes capacidades.
 User Assistance — suporte ao usuário.
 Self-Descriptiveness — interface autoexplicativa.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 4. Interaction Capability
Um usuário sem treinamento prévio deve ser capaz de registrar seu primeiro pedido completo em até 10 
minutos. A interface deve seguir as diretrizes WCAG 2.1 nível AA.
5. Reliability (Confiabilidade)
 Faultlessness — ausência de falhas em condições normais.
 Availability — proporção de tempo em que o sistema está operacional.
 Fault Tolerance — operação correta mesmo com falhas parciais.
 Recoverability — recuperação após falha.
EXEMPLO — RNF — 5. Reliability
O sistema deve ter disponibilidade mínima de 99,5% ao mês (máx. 3,6h de downtime não planejado). Em 
caso de falha crítica, o sistema deve restaurar a operação normal em até 4 horas (RTO = 4h).

Rastrear os Requisitos PE (5.1)
Propósito
O objetivo de Rastrear os Requisitos é garantir que os requisitos e designs em 
diferentes níveis estejam alinhados entre si e gerenciar os efeitos da 
mudança em um nível nos requisitos relacionados.
Descrição
Rastrear os Requisitos: analisa e mantém os relacionamentos entre 
requisitos, designs, componentes de solução e outros produtos de trabalho 
para análise de impacto, cobertura e alocação.
Entradas
• Requisitos: podem ser rastreados para outros requisitos (incluindo 
metas, objetivos, requisitos de negócio, requisitos de stakeholder, 
requisitos de solução e requisitos de transição), componentes de 
solução, recursos visuais, regras de negócio e outros produtos de 
trabalho.
• Designs: podem ser rastreados para outros requisitos, componentes de

em_escopo: Account creation for any visitor, with no verification process
Book search by exact title match (logged-in users)
Viewing book title, author, and price
Shopping cart with a limit of one copy per book per order
Checkout flow that collects a card number, generates a receipt, and logs the purchase
Member signup to receive promotion notifications and use promo codes at checkout
Manager login to manage inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock)
Automatic low-stock email alert to the manager, with per-book opt-out
Manager-created percentage-off promotions with automatic email to all members
fora_de_escopo: Real credit card / payment processing — deferred to a later phase
Encryption — not a priority for this version
Password recovery — not a priority for this version
Multiple manager accounts or manager roles — only one manager
Partial/fuzzy search or search by author — title search is exact-match only
Multiple copies of the same book per order — limited to one
premissas: PA-01: Only one person will operate the manager account for the store.
restricoes: REST-01 (Tecnica): The system must be usable through a normal web browser, with no exotic client-side requirements.

stakeholders.descricao: Store Manager — the single account responsible for managing inventory (add books, edit prices, view stock) and creating promotions; must never also be a regular customer account.
Visitor — anyone arriving at the site who can create an account with no verification process.
Registered User / Customer — logged-in user who can search for books, add them to a cart, and check out.
Member — a registered user who opted in to promotion notifications; the only type of user who can apply promo codes at checkout.

regras_de_negocio.descricao: A cart may contain at most one copy of each distinct book per order.
A manager account must never also function as a regular customer account.
Only members (not all registered users) can apply promo codes at checkout.
The low-stock email alert to the manager is suppressed for a given book if the manager has disabled notifications for that specific book.
Creating a new percentage-off promotion automatically triggers an email to all members.

requisitos_funcionais.descricao: The system must allow any visitor to create an account with no verification process.
The system must allow logged-in users to search for books by title using an exact match only (no partial match, no search by author).
The system must display each book's title, author, and price.
The system must allow users to add a book to their shopping cart.
The system must prevent a user from adding more than one copy of the same book to their cart in a single order.
The system must allow users to complete checkout for the items in their cart.
The system must allow a registered user to sign up as a member to receive promotion notifications.
The system must allow members to apply a promo code during checkout.
The system must provide a login for the manager, separate from customer accounts.
The system must allow the manager to add new books to the inventory.
The system must allow the manager to edit the price of existing books.
The system must allow the manager to view current stock levels.
The system must send an email notification to the manager when a book's stock is low, unless notifications are disabled for that book.
The system must allow the manager to create percentage-off promotions.
The system must automatically email all members when a new promotion is created.
The system must collect a card number during checkout without processing an actual payment.
The system must generate a receipt after checkout.
The system must log each purchase, including the item, the buyer, and the timestamp.

requisitos_nao_funcionais.descricao: The system must be usable through a standard web browser, with no exotic or non-standard client-side requirements.

historias_de_usuario.descricao: As a visitor, I want to create an account with no verification process, so that I can start using the site quickly.
As a registered user, I want to search for a book by its exact title, so that I can find the book I'm looking for.
As a registered user, I want to view a book's title, author, and price, so that I can decide whether to buy it.
As a registered user, I want to add a book to my cart, so that I can purchase it later.
As a registered user, I want to check out my cart, so that I can complete my purchase.
As a member, I want to apply a promo code at checkout, so that I can get a discount.
As the manager, I want to add new books and edit their prices, so that I can keep the catalog up to date.
As the manager, I want to be notified when a book's stock is low, so that I can restock in time.
As the manager, I want to create percentage-off promotions, so that I can attract more sales.
As a member, I want to receive an email when a new promotion is created, so that I know about current deals.

casos_de_uso.descricao: Search and Purchase Book — a logged-in user searches for a book by exact title, adds it to the cart, and completes checkout.
Manage Inventory — the manager logs in and adds new books, edits prices, or views current stock levels.
Create Promotion — the manager creates a percentage-off promotion, and the system automatically emails all members.

criterios_de_aceite.descricao: Given a logged-in user, when they search for a book title that exactly matches an existing book, then the system returns that book with its title, author, and price.
Given a user already has one copy of a book in their cart, when they try to add another copy of the same book, then the system prevents the second copy from being added.
Given a member is at checkout with a valid promo code, when they apply the code, then the system applies the corresponding discount.
Given a book's stock drops below the defined threshold and notifications are enabled for that book, when the stock update occurs, then the system sends an email to the manager.
Given the manager creates a new percentage-off promotion, when the promotion is saved, then the system automatically sends an email to all members.
